200.description: A page of status list records

uri.description: Public URL of the Status List Token, the value every credential registered on the list carries in status.status_list.uri

size.description: Number of entries of the list

createdAt.description: When the agent created the list

updatedAt.description: The iat of the last token the agent published for the list

nextCursor.description: Cursor of the next page. The agent sets it to null on the last page.
